responsibility: Defines the PowerPC Darwin-specific option metadata used by the rs6000 driver and target. It records Darwin forms of Altivec and fix-and-continue compatibility flags and the target-side m32/m64 mode switches, supplying the option-table entries that Darwin headers and specs use to select code model, ABI width, and legacy driver aliases.
same_name_distinction: This is the option-definition member of the Darwin group: it records driver/target switches such as faltivec aliases, fix-and-continue compatibility, and m32/m64 selection, rather than Darwin ABI/spec macros in darwin.h or Mach-O RTL patterns in darwin.md.
